answer_1.quote: Definition Modeling (DM), i.e. the task of generating a gloss from static or contextual embeddings.

answer_2.quote: We report results with BLEU and ROUGE-L ... we also report results with METEOR ... and BERTScore ... Additionally, we report results (precision@k) on their retrieval task ...

answer_4.quote: We hired three annotators with Master's Degrees in Linguistics ... we asked them to assign a graded value to the definitions based on their pertinence to describing the target t in c, according to a five‑level Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to assign a graded value on a five‑level Likert scale based on the pertinence of the definition to describing the target in context.
